text:
Ana (devex): Hey team — flagged by a new user: our README quickstart in the sample-app has stale env var and import, causing 401s.
Mike (sdk): Ugh, thanks for catching. Do you have the exact lines?
Ana (devex): Pasted from gist they sent:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
```
Ana (devex): They said `pip install redwood` failed and the sample CLI in the readme points to /v1/stream which returns 404.
Sophia (docs): Yep that's old. SDK was renamed to `redwood_inference` and env var is `REDWOOD_KEY`. Also streaming path moved to `/v1/generate/stream` in the hosted API.
Ben (support): Customer reported they'd almost dropped the eval because the quickstart didn't run out of the box :facepalm:. We should hotfix.
Mike (sdk): I'll open a small PR to replace imports and env var + update the curl examples. I'll add a migration note for older tutorials.
Sasha (devex): Assign to me for the sample-app readme changes and tests. I'll also add a tiny smoke test in CI that runs the quickstart with mock creds.
docs-bot: Created issue <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2345|#2345> for README quickstart drift. Assigned to Sasha.
Sasha (devex): Plan: change snippet to:
```python
import os
from redwood_inference import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate("Hello")
```
Sasha (devex): And replace curl with:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Mike (sdk): Also add note about package rename in the changelog and a compatibility alias for one release so old imports don't 500.
Ana (devex): Can we also add a tiny check in the onboarding flow that warns if env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is set and suggests migrating? That would help newbies.
Ben (support): 100%. Customers appreciate hint messages in CLI.
Sasha (devex): I'll have the PR up by EOD. Will include tests and link the updated sample app repo.
Mike (sdk): Thanks — if you want I can push a small compatibility shim to PyPI under `redwood` that imports from `redwood_inference` for one release.
Ana (devex): :thumbsup: Great. Filing a follow-up to monitor churn metric after the doc update.
Ben (support): Noted — flagged as high priority for this week.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 - title: "quickstart: update package name, env var, and endpoints"
Sasha (devex): Leaving review requests for @Mike and @Sophia. Please review asap so we can hotfix the live docs.
Sophia (docs): Will review in an hour.
Mike (sdk): Reviewing now. Small nit: add a note about async streaming signature change.
Sasha (devex): Will add.
Ben (support): Thanks team — keeping customer updated in support thread.
